description:
Amateur radio logbook software.

QLog is an Amateur Radio logging application for Linux, Windows. It is based on the Qt framework and uses SQLite as database backend.
QLogs aims to be as simple as possible, but to provide everything the operator expects from the log to be. This log is not currently focused on contests.
- Fixed OmnirigDrv - CW and CWR follow the rig's own normal CW (issue #347 PR #1196 @SebaBecks)
- Fixed QSLPrint - Ensure QSL PDF exports use a PDF extension
- Improved file error context and unify error dialogs
- Fixed Flatpak file access and safe export handling
- Fixed CTY DXCC matching and geographic overrides (issue #1221)
- Fixed Club Log DXCC exact-match column alignment
- DXCC - Preserve host prefixes when resolving numeric callsign suffixes
- Fixed eQSL profile callsign matching
- Fixed eQSL submode matching
Fix omnirigCW (#347) note:
When using this version for the first time, switching to CW may select CW-R on some radios. If this happens, select your preferred CW mode on the radio. QLog will remember that choice, including after a restart. If the radio is already in CW, QLog will keep its current CW variant. It remembers the last variant you used, so choosing CW-R later will also be respected.
Fix CTY DXCC matching and geographic overrides (#1221) note:
You need to either wait for the regular DXCC entity update or force it using the -f option.
